data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for CAS.AI mobile ads mediation for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: The CAS.AI plugin lets you monetize your Flutter applications for Android and iOS using multiple ad networks via mediation. It offers refined ad formats and streamlined APIs to manage and load advertisements.
use_when: You want to monetize your mobile app using multiple ad networks through a single mediation SDK.
You are targeting Android and iOS platforms.
avoid_when: You only want to integrate a single ad network directly without mediation.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Combines multiple ad networks via mediation in a single API.
Provides official Flutter support with regular updates tracking native SDK releases.
weaknesses: Requires managing native SDK version requirements like minimum Android API levels and iOS versions.
Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up native Android and iOS dependencies, with a minimum Android API level of 24 and iOS version 15.0 as of version 4.8.3.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer to integrate Google AdMob and Google Ad Manager directly instead of using a third-party mediation platform.
